verdict.rationale: Docs confirm document/spreadsheet/PDF upload and analysis (draft/refine documents, presentations, spreadsheets, PDFs; 'analyze files'; 'read files, analyze data, and summarize findings'), which directly matches the story. However, evidence is entirely first-party documentation with no independent hands-on validation of accuracy specifically for uploaded file analysis (community evidence covers unrelated web-search accuracy issues, not file analysis). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of analysis accuracy on real uploaded documents/spreadsheets/PDFs, and detail on limits (file size, complex spreadsheet formulas, OCR quality).
